# oxide_system_subnet_pool_silo_link (Resource)

This resource manages a system subnet pool's link to a silo.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oxide_system_subnet_pool_silo_link" "example" {
  pool = "my-pool"
  silo = "my-silo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool` (String) Name or ID of the subnet pool to link to the silo.
- `silo` (String) Name or ID of the silo to link to the subnet pool.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default subnet pool for the silo. When true, external subnet allocations that don't specify a pool use this one.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this resource, formatted as `subnet_pool_id/silo_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is the format `${SUBNET_POOL_ID}/${SILO_ID}`.
terraform import oxide_system_subnet_pool_silo_link.example 3e2c6e84-bed8-4c94-afc3-1032082d6a90/9e199e45-01a6-43d3-8bc3-5b27726e67a6
```
